build_WarmupOneCycleLR: build a WarmupOneCycleLR scheduler with cosine annealing and momentum scheduling for a PyTorch optimizer
build_WarmupMultiStepLR: build a WarmupMultiStepLR scheduler with warmup and gamma-based step decay for a PyTorch optimizer
build_scheduler_factory: build a learning rate scheduler by name using build_scheduler with an optimizer and constructor kwargs
test_annealing_cos: test the annealing_cos function to cosine anneal a value from start to end over a percentage
test_annealing_linear: test the annealing_linear function to linearly anneal a value from start to end over a percentage
